name: @va-team/nabu-email
description: Send and fetch emails via the VA.Team backend API

allowNonMainAgents.description: When true, agents other than `main` may use this plugin. Default false. Product gate only — the backend remains the authorization boundary.

apiToken.description: Per-organization skill token issued by the backend SMTP module; authenticates the gateway↔backend channel only. Requests carry x-organization-id (env-derived); per-user mailbox routing is by agentId from trusted tool context, never from the tool schema. Accepts either a literal string or a SecretRef object {source, provider, id} resolved from env.
